alin (Design): quick pass on the nested filter panel: keyboard users can't tell which filter group is focused when you open the hierarchy. the visual cue is a subtle left border only. screenshot: https://img.redwood/filters/nested.png :mag: tara (Frontend): this is the left-hand filter drawer with groups and nested checklists, correct? we render groups as headings and the children as checkboxes. alin (Design): yep. when you tab into the drawer VO says 'group' but doesn't indicate which item inside has focus. arrow keys move a visual highlight but SR doesn't follow reliably. anya (A11y): sounds like focus is not being moved to a real focusable control when arrows change selection. SRs need an explicit focused element. Use roving tabindex for the list items or manage focus on the checkbox input itself. Also ensure group headings use `role=\"group\" aria-label=\" filters\"` so SR announces context. tara (Frontend): current markup: `

Language

Python
...
` 9 (we style the divs to look like checkboxes). anya (A11y): problem: divs are not native controls. Replace visual-only divs with `` or at minimum give the div `role=\"checkbox\" tabindex=0 aria-checked=\"false\"`. Prefer native inputs for reliability. alin (Design): design-wise we used custom check visuals to allow multi-column layout. can we keep the look but swap to native inputs visually hidden? tara (Frontend): yes, we can visually hide the native input and style the label. that maintains semantics. We'll also add `aria-live=\"polite\"` SR announcer that says e.g., "Language: Python selected, 12 results" when a filter changes. Debounce to 400ms. anya (A11y): good. also add keyboard handling: - Tab into group jumps to first checkbox - Arrow keys move focus between checkboxes within the group - Home/End to go to first/last - Space toggles checkbox state. Use roving tabindex to keep only one tabindex=0. dev-qa: test matrix: VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS. Scenarios: keyboard only navigate into group, arrow navigation announced, toggling announces selection and result count, nested groups collapse/expand announces state. anya (A11y): collapse/expand needs `aria-expanded` on the group toggle and `aria-controls` referencing the list. When collapsed, set `hidden` or `aria-hidden=\"true\"` on children so SRs skip them. Announce " collapsed"/"expanded" via polite live region too. tara (Frontend): contrast note: the selected state uses a 2px accent border on dark theme with accent color #5b21b6 on #0b0f12 — border contrast is low. For focus we want a visible outline that meets 3:1 vs the background. I'll change selected background to #111318 and add a 3px outline `rgba(91,33,182,0.95)` for keyboard focus. alin (Design): prefer to keep subtle visuals, but accessibility first — outline ok. also copy nit: announcer message should be short: "Python filter applied, 12 results" vs long verbose. keep consistent format: `": , results"`. anya (A11y): that format is fine. Also ensure the result count is current (debounced after filters settle). For nested counts include parent context when helpful: "Framework filters: React (3 selected), 42 results". dev-qa: I'll add steps: verify Home/End behavior, verify aria-expanded on group toggles, verify aria-live messages don't repeat rapidly on rapid toggles. tara (Frontend): estimate 4 dev hours: replace divs with inputs, implement roving tabindex/arrow keys, add aria-live announcer + debounce, adjust focus CSS. PR -> https://git.redwood/pr/9955 (WIP). preview -> https://deploy-preview.redwood/9955 ci-bot: accessibility-lint: filter-checkbox-role (medium), filter-focus-visibility (low). https://ci.redwood/a11y/2423456789 anya (A11y): ping me on the PR and I'll run quick VoiceOver + NVDA passes. Also include unit test asserting `aria-expanded` toggles when group collapsed/expanded. alin (Design): great, thanks. small follow-up: can we add aria-label on the filter drawer close button like "Close filter panel"? helps SR users. tara (Frontend): will do. thanks all ":thumbsup:"
